title: Welcome to Greek Flashcards
description: A quick sample deck to try out studying before you load your own topic.

cards.front: How do I add a new topic?
cards.back: Give Claude a file (notes, PDF, doc) in chat and ask it to add a deck — it'll drop a new folder right here.

cards.front: How do I flip a card?
cards.back: Tap or click the card. On desktop you can also press Space or Enter.

cards.front: How do I move to the next card?
cards.back: Swipe left, tap Next, or press the right arrow key.

cards.front: Can I use this on my iPhone?
cards.back: Yes — open it in Safari and tap Share > Add to Home Screen to install it like a real app.
